The metal trim and nib show signs of wear, while the imprints and pattern on the pen remain clear.

They exhibit different shades of brown with visible grain patterns and show signs of prior use with some darkening inside the bowls. The wood and stems are intact with minor wear, making this collection suitable for enthusiasts or collectors of vintage smoking pipes.
